ItemID: unavailable; Title: NEIKO 50432A Hex Nut Assortment Set | 150 Pc Nylon Locking Nuts | A3 Steel Hex Assorted Hardware Kit #10 & SAE | Metal Screw Nut for Bolts | Friction Lock Nut; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy repair supplies, but I have no current need for these nut sizes.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent repairs do not suggest metal cutting, and I may not have a compatible grinder.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Bolt Dropper 1/2" Stainless Flat Finish Washer, 1-1/4" Outside Diameter - 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel, Highly Corrosion-Resistant and Rustproof - Convenient for Any Project Needs (50 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Fifty washers in one specific size are more than I would choose without a matching project.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: CRC 05103 QD Electronic Cleaner -11 Wt Oz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This looks useful for cleaning electrical connections during the kinds of repairs I buy connectors for.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My tape and vinyl cement purchases make a strong repair adhesive appealing, though a two-pack may be more than I need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld 8277 WaterWeld Epoxy Putty Stick - 2 oz., Off White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in practical repairs, but I would choose the general epoxy this time without a specific wet-area repair.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: STAR BRITE Liquid Electrical Tape - 4 FL Oz Can With Applicator Brush Cap - Protective, Airtight, Waterproof, Flexible, Dielectric Coating - Indoor & Outdoor Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The flexible waterproof coating looks particularly useful for insulating connections alongside my crimp connector supplies.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: No. 6 x 1/2" Stainless Truss Head Phillips Wood Screw, (100 pc), 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel Sheet Metal Screws, Type A Point, Plain Finish by Bolt Dropper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need to know the required screw dimensions before buying a hundred of these.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: NEIKO 11107A 10 Pack Aluminum Oxide Flap Discs 4-1/2 for Angle Grinder, 60 Grit Flapper Wheel, Flat T27 Grinding Wheel 4.5 Inch Flap Disc, 7/8" Arbor Grinding Disc, Wood & Metal Sanding; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no evident sanding project or established need for angle-grinder consumables.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: No. 10-24 Nylon Insert Lock Nut (100 Pieces) Stainless Steel Finish Hex Lock Nuts, 304 (18-8) Stainless Plain Finish Corrosion Resistant Commercial Grade by Bolt Dropper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My clamp purchases do not establish a need for this thread size, so I would skip a bulk pack.
